cues.text: When a customer picks up altered clothes, a quick check and a try-on make sure they leave happy.
Check the work against the ticket. Was every job done?
Hems and sleeves are even on both sides.
It is pressed, with no fold lines from pinning.
No loose threads and no pins left inside.
Ask: would you like to try it on? This is the best time to catch a problem.
If it fits, great. Take payment and mark it picked up.
If it is not right, stay calm. Pin it again, write a clear note, and give it back to the tailor. Ask the manager about any charges.
